title: Accountancy
award: Certificate of Achievement: 18  or greater semester(or 27  or greater quarter) u

outcomes: Create accurate, reliable, and relevant accounting documents and reports for decision makers using the information.
Demonstrate effective use of accounting software applications considered applicable to the current accounting environment.
Demonstrate an understanding of basic accounting terminology and the process by which transactions are analyzed, evaluated, and communicated into the financial statements.
Understand and practice high ethical standards with internal and external stakeholders.
Prepare a federal and California individual income tax return in proper form according to current federal and state tax rules and regulations.
Demonstrate the ability to compute, record, and verify quantitative and qualitative information in order to maintain financial records.

notes: The first outcome is printed on the same line as the lead-in 'Students who complete the Accountancy Program will be able to:'; the lead-in was omitted. The outcomes are stated for the Accountancy Program as a whole and recorded for this certificate.
Career 'accountancy' is taken from the note 'recommended preparation for employment in the field of accountancy'; reviewer may judge whether this counts as a named career field.
CISC 181 (4 units) is required in the catalog but not in the closed list; marked as catalog addition.
Competence in Microsoft Excel is noted as recommended preparation but is not a course, so no recommended block was recorded.
